topic: What if everyone disappeared except you?

script.text: The hiding place is the old tree house at the end of the park. You climb up, and there she is, wrapped in a blanket, holding the other walkie-talkie. She hugs you so hard you can't breathe.

Across the river, the lit window flickers, and goes out. 3:07. The door is closed. It's just the two of you now. Noodle barks once from the bottom of the ladder. And far away, on the bridge, a tiny figure in a grey suit is standing still, looking straight at your torch.
Or is it? Because Ellie's walkie-talkie crackles one more time, and a voice you have never heard before says: 'We can see your torch. There are more of us. Don't trust the man in the suit.'
Ellie looks at you. 'Who was that?' You don't know. But somewhere out there in the dark, someone has been watching you for twelve days.
Would you have gone through the door? Tell us in the comments. Part two is coming.
Is any of this real? The disappearing, no. But the blackout, the flooding subway, the reactors and the loneliness? All real. The sources are in the description.
